sources.role: Literal Q2^80 and original two-field I80 constructor, no ext attribute
sources.raw_excerpt:
def Q : ℕ := 2 ^ 80

theorem Q_pos : (0 : ℚ) < Q := by norm_num [Q]
theorem Q_ne_zero : (Q : ℚ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt Q_pos

structure I80 where
  lo : ℤ
  hi : ℤ

sources.role: Original coordinate decoding/division implementation and already-used constructor congruence API
sources.raw_excerpt:
def I80.decodeLo (x : I80) : ℚ := (x.lo : ℚ) / Q
def I80.decodeHi (x : I80) : ℚ := (x.hi : ℚ) / Q
def I80.enclosure (x : I80) : Enclosure := ⟨x.decodeLo, x.decodeHi⟩
def I80.Contains (x : I80) (v : ℝ) : Prop := x.enclosure.Contains v

/-- Convert exact rational endpoints with precisely one directed Q80 round. -/
def I80.ofEnclosure (x : Enclosure) : I80 :=
  ⟨⌊x.lower * Q⌋, ⌈x.upper * Q⌉⟩

def I80.point (q : ℚ) : I80 := I80.ofEnclosure (Enclosure.point q)
def I80.raw (n : ℤ) : I80 := ⟨n, n⟩
def I80.add (x y : I80) : I80 := ⟨x.lo + y.lo, x.hi + y.hi⟩
def I80.neg (x : I80) : I80 := ⟨-x.hi, -x.lo⟩
def I80.sub (x y : I80) : I80 := x.add y.neg
def I80.mul (x y : I80) : I80 := I80.ofEnclosure (x.enclosure.mul y.enclosure)

/-- The literal producer asserts `0 < y.lo` before this operation.
The formula itself remains total; soundness retains that guard. -/
def I80.div (x y : I80) : I80 :=
  I80.ofEnclosure (x.enclosure.divisionBounds y.enclosure)

theorem I80.enclosure_ofEnclosure (x : Enclosure) :
    (I80.ofEnclosure x).enclosure = x.round 80 := by
  apply congrArg₂ Enclosure.mk <;>
    norm_num [I80.ofEnclosure, I80.enclosure, I80.decodeLo, I80.decodeHi,

sources.role: Original unit integer interval contains its exact rational decoded value
sources.raw_excerpt:
theorem I80.raw_contains (n : ℤ) :
    (I80.raw n).Contains (((n : ℚ) / Q : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
  exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩

sources.role: Exact existing Int/Nat cast and Rat one normalization
sources.raw_excerpt:
theorem cast_intCast (n : ℤ) : ((n : ℚ) : α) = n :=
  (cast_def _).trans <| show (n / (1 : ℕ) : α) = n by rw [Nat.cast_one, div_one]

@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem cast_natCast (n : ℕ) : ((n : ℚ) : α) = n := by
  rw [← Int.cast_natCast, cast_intCast, Int.cast_natCast]


@[simp, norm_cast] lemma cast_ofNat (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] :
    ((ofNat(n) : ℚ) : α) = (ofNat(n) : α) := by
  simp [cast_def]

@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem cast_zero : ((0 : ℚ) : α) = 0 :=
  (cast_intCast _).trans Int.cast_zero

@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem cast_one : ((1 : ℚ) : α) = 1 :=
  (cast_intCast _).trans Int.cast_one

implementation: congrArg₂ I80.mk applies the imported original constructor; no new ext theorem or attribute is introduced. The same constructor proof shape is already in I80.enclosure_ofEnclosure for Enclosure.mk.
classification: Ordinary proof API and explicit exact rational cast normalization only.
